annotation.title_clean: Décision n° 2021-834 DC du 20 janvier 2022 - Loi relative à la responsabilité pénale et à la sécurité intérieure
annotation.title_en: Decision No. 2021-834 DC of 20 January 2022 - Law on criminal responsibility and internal security
annotation.venue: Conseil constitutionnel website; JORF n°0020 du 25 janvier 2022
annotation.summary_en: French Constitutional Council decision reviewing the 2022 internal security law. It strikes down the emergency and municipal police provisions for airborne cameras (drones) and upholds the prefect-authorised state drone surveillance and judicial police drone use, subject to interpretive reservations. The reservations ban facial recognition and require subsidiarity and time limits.
key_provisions_or_claims: Struck down the emergency 4-hour drone deployment without prefect authorisation (art. 15) as a disproportionate privacy intrusion.
Struck down the municipal police experimental drone regime (L. 242-7).
Upheld prefect-authorised drone surveillance, subject to reservations: subsidiarity (no less intrusive means) and renewal only if drones remain the sole means.
Drones may not carry facial recognition or interconnect with other personal data files; no sound capture.
Upheld judicial-police drone surveillance (arts. 230-47 to 230-53 CPP) under judicial control with time limits.
